input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 is a full vendor insurance clause meeting the preferred position on every element: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, and Vendor does process Customer Data per Section 17), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates of insurance on request under Section 18.2. No qualifier elsewhere in the document dilutes these limits; Section 18.2 adds favourable extras (primary coverage, notice of cancellation, insurance not limiting liability). No redline required.
